messages:
Marie: Quick design review — worried the KMS copy on the region selector is ambiguous. 'Customer-managed key (KMS)' looks like a feature toggle rather than an ownership/permission detail.
Daniel: Agreed. Users skim that dropdown when creating resources. We should make the ownership intent explicit and shorter.
Rachel: Can you propose a line? I'd like to avoid adding extra UI space.
Marie: Proposal A: 'KMS key (customer-managed)'. Proposal B: 'Customer key (KMS) — you control the key'. B is longer tho.
Sam: From security perspective: include 'managed by you' words is good. Also avoid "key" as the only noun — some customers use CMKs vs imported keys.
Daniel: What about a compact label + tooltip? Label: 'Customer key (KMS)'. Tooltip: 'Use your KMS key for encryption; Redwood does not have access unless you grant it.'
Rachel: Tooltip text ok but needs to be accessible. We should add an aria-describedby id for the tooltip anchor.
Marie: Right — UX nit: the current tooltip icon is visually small and not keyboard-focusable. We need it in the tab order.
Daniel: Tiny mock: `KMS label` followed by a help icon (button) with aria-label="KMS help" and aria-describedby pointing to a visually-hidden paragraph with the explanation.
Rachel: Implementation note — our tooltip component supports `role="button"` but not focus by default. I'll update it to use `<button>` for assistive tech.
Sam: Copy tweak suggestion for the tooltip (short): 'Encrypts data with your KMS key. You control access and rotation.' Longer variant for audit docs: 'Encrypts data using a customer-managed key (KMS). You retain control over key access, rotation, and export.'
Marie: I like the short one for inline help. Also small UI change: when retention is set to 'custom', we show region + KMS selectors on the same row — current wrap looks messy. Can we keep them aligned?
Daniel: Layout idea: two-column compact form on desktop, stacked on mobile. That should solve wrap. Add aria-describedby linking retention to region explanation.
Rachel: I'll adjust CSS grid: `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px;` and add `@media (max-width: 640px)` stacking.
Marie: Audit log phrasing: when a user switches KMS from 'Redwood-managed' to 'Customer-managed', the audit entry currently says 'kms toggled'. We need clearer entries.
Sam: New audit copy suggestion: 'Encryption key ownership changed: Redwood-managed -> Customer-managed (KMS) by <user>'. Also capture previous key id if present.
audit-bot: Remember: audit entries are immutable. Ensure you include both previous and new value in the log payload.
Rachel: Backend note: we'll include fields `prev_key_owner` and `new_key_owner` in the log, then render friendly text in the console.
Daniel: Accessibility nit: contrast of the 'Managed by you' badge is weak on light background. Increase contrast to WCAG AA at least.
Marie: Final ask before dev: can design approve the compact label + tooltip copy and the audit phrasing? If yes, Rachel will push the PR and Sam will do a quick security review on the text.
Daniel: Approved from design — prefer: Label = 'Customer key (KMS)'; Tooltip = 'Encrypts data with your KMS key. You control access and rotation.' Reduce tooltip to one sentence.
Sam: Security review done, wording is accurate. Please include a link to KMS docs in the tooltip footer: '/docs/security/kms'.
Rachel: I'll open a small PR with the layout change, aria updates, and audit log payload additions. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Marie: Awesome — thanks all. :thumbsup:
